name: Trouble@Vampire! ~Ano Ko wa Ore no Goshujin-sama~
original_name: とらぶる＠ヴァンパイア！～あの娘は俺のご主人さま～
source:
Ritsu is a new teacher at a prestigious ‘classical’ all-girls school. One day, he saves his students by protecting them from some magic, but ended up getting severely hurt. When he woke up, he saw a girl named Shion, who actually is a vampire. She called him her servant since she had bit him to save him from death after he had lost too much blood.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/10/01/october-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
